gameDescriptionHtml:
Dust & Courage: Jake Bolton’s Journey is an isometric single-player RPG that thrusts you into a fantastical Wild West America. Step into Jake Bolton’s boots and shape his destiny in a land of outlaws, legends, and mystic secrets. Every decision is yours to make, and every choice carves your legend in the frontier.

Ride through dusty towns, lawless outposts, and untamed landscapes brimming with quests, hidden treasures, and colorful characters. Go where you want, do what you want! This sandbox Wild West adventure is your own.

Game Features

  • CHOOSE YOUR OWN STORY – Diplomacy or danger? Friend or foe? You decide. Engage in quests where your dialogue and actions truly matter. Resolve conflicts by talking your way out or by drawing your six-shooter. Allies and enemies remember your actions; your choices will trigger consequences that ripple across the world, altering storylines and character relationships. Strap on your irons and get ready for gunfights. Wield a variety of weapons, from trusty revolvers and shotguns to fists and knives, each with strategic advantages. Study your enemies’ weaknesses and adapt on the fly: use cover, terrain, and clever tactics to outsmart bandits and fantastical creatures alike. Whether you talk down a gang leader or blast your way through, the way you survive is up to you.
  • SHAPE THE WORLD AROUND YOU – In the Wild West, word travels fast. Build a reputation as a righteous lawman, a notorious outlaw, or anything in between. Your alignment and deeds affect how NPCs and factions treat you: earn trust to gain allies, special quests, even exclusive gear or instill fear and face the reckoning of vengeful enemies. Every action opens some doors while it may close others, ensuring no two journeys are the same. Level up Jake’s skills to match your playstyle. Become a crack shot gunslinger, a silver-tongued negotiator, a resourceful survivalist or a bit of everything. Tailor your arsenal and skills, and become the cowboy you want to be.
  • CREATE YOUR DREAM COWBOY – As you progress, you can level up Jake Bolton’s skills and abilities, including proficiency with various weapons, persuasion, and survival skills. Abilities range from combat techniques to social skills like charisma and intimidation. Saddle up and experience an epic Western saga filled with tough decisions, rich storytelling, and the freedom to walk your own path. Will you bring justice to the frontier or leave chaos in your wake? The choice is yours in Dust & Courage: Jake Bolton’s Journey, an unforgettable Wild West adventure where legend awaits.
